patterns.note: Full-width content sections with clear vertical stacking and generous padding, often featuring a distinct background color or image.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for major titles, contrasting with a more neutral sans-serif for body text and smaller uppercase labels for categories.
A high-contrast palette of dark grey/black and white is accented by a vibrant, singular red for calls to action and key highlights.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background that scrolls with a subtle parallax effect, while the overlaid text content scrolls normally.
Product categories and blog posts are presented in a responsive grid layout, with each item featuring an image and concise text.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed-position header that remains visible at the top of the screen throughout the scroll, ensuring navigation is always accessible.

Utilize a full-bleed video as the background for the hero section, applying a dark, semi-transparent overlay to enhance text readability. Position the main hero text and call-to-action button absolutely over this video background.

Structure content into distinct, full-width sections that stack vertically. Use varying background colors (white, light grey, or full-bleed images) to visually separate these sections as the user scrolls.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) for impact, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like buttons and image cards feature slightly rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density with an airy hero section, transitioning to a more structured, clear vertical rhythm between content blocks and within grid layouts.

standout: The site's design stands out with its impactful video hero, which immediately conveys product context and quality. The combination of industrial-grade product imagery, bold typography, and a strong red accent creates a distinctive, authoritative, and modern aesthetic that avoids generic marketing templates.
